title_en: Reply of the Administrative Division of the Supreme People's Court on the Request for Instructions concerning the Application of Document No. 41 [1994] of the State Council

articles.content_en:
Administrative Adjudication Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court
Reply concerning the Application of State Council Document Guo Fa [1994] No. 41
on Issues Raised in the Request for Instructions
June 4, 1997 [1997] Fa Xing Zi No. 6
Higher People's Court of Shanxi Province:
We have received your Request [1997] Jin Fa Xing Zi No. 1. Upon study, we reply as follows:
We agree with the inclined opinion of the Adjudication Committee of your court, that is, the administrative authorities for industry and commerce, in accordance with relevant provisions, intercepting a specific vehicle reported as suspected of transporting counterfeit liquor and taking provisional seizure measures on the suspected counterfeit liquor being carried does not constitute acts of setting up roadblocks on the road for inspection expressly prohibited by State Council Document Guo Fa [1994] No. 41.
